specifications.Item Highlight: Lightweight, compact 3-season mummy bag with contoured hood, draft collar and anti-snag zipper for backpacking

bullets: Tailored Fit & Lightweight: The Women’s Long model fits adventurers up to 6’ / 183 cm, weighs only 3 lb 9 oz, and compresses down to 11” x 10”, making it an ideal compact sleeping bag for your backpacking gear kit.

Women’s Specific Construction: Designed with increased insulation and a tailored silhouette that contours to a woman’s body, creating a more thermally efficient sleep system and a better night's rest.
FireLine Pro Eco Insulation: Utilizes 100% recycled multi-denier, short-staple synthetic fibers to provide reliable, efficient warmth and excellent compressibility even in damp camping conditions.
Sustainable Technical Fabrics: Constructed with a soft, cozy recycled shell and lining featuring a PFAS-free water-repellent finish, offering an eco-friendly solution for your outdoor gear needs.
User-Friendly Features: Outfitted with a two-way anti-snag zipper on the sleeper’s right side for smooth operation and easy foot venting, plus the ability to mate with men's/unisex bags.
